item.description: Tell us who is going on leave, you or a colleague. Microsoft 365 access is paused on the start date (or right away) and turned back on when they return.
item.subject: Employee Leave
item.thankYou: We're setting this up now. You'll get a desktop notification when it's done or scheduled. Ticket #@TicketId.

questions.label: Header
questions.defaultValue:
Employee leave
Going on leave, or is someone on your team? Microsoft 365 access is paused securely on the start date (or right away), and turned back on when they return.

questions.label: Employee going on leave
questions.info: Their work email address, or your own if the leave is yours.

questions.label: Type of leave
questions.options: Leave of absence,Parental leave,Extended vacation,Sabbatical,Returning from leave

questions.label: Leave starts
questions.info: Leave blank to pause access as soon as you submit. Pick a later date to schedule it, even for your own leave.

questions.label: Expected return date
questions.info: Optional. Access turns back on automatically that morning.

questions.label: Update their access
questions.defaultValue: workflow:<id of your imported Employee Leave (Microsoft 365) workflow>
